title: Sonic Rumble Party

anticheat.note: listed with Uncheater and marked broken on Linux, yet the reporter played over 30 online matches on a Mac

provenance: Reported by AnonSleepiGuy (highball-db#1041, 2026-11-07), Apple M3 Pro, macOS 26.5.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 49 minutes: over 30 matches in about an hour, with Windows 11 as the Windows version and a 60 fps cap. On an older Highball version the controls sometimes didn't register until a click outside the game window and back in. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on an M3 Pro with DXMT on the default engine (r28), over 30 online matches in about an hour.
